// CASE swift_closure_param_shadow expect=pass
func closureParam(_ plans: [Plan]) async throws {
  let limit = 1
  try await probe(limit)
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for plan in plans {
      group.addTask {
        let limit = plan.limit
        try await mapWithConcurrency(plan.items, limit, save)
      }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}

  let width = 1
  try await probe(width)
  if let width = config.width {
    try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save)
  }
}
// CASE swift_for_in_shadow expect=pass
func forIn(_ items: [Int], _ widths: [Int]) async throws {
  let width = 1
  try await probe(width)
  try await withThrowingTaskGroup(of: Void.self) { group in
    for width in widths {
      group.addTask { try await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, save) }
    }
    try await group.waitForAll()
  }
}
